atoms.1: A non-reactive result for the Hepatitis A IgM antibody test indicates that there is no detectable level of IgM antibodies against the Hepatitis A virus in the blood sample.
atoms.2: A non-reactive result for the Hepatitis A IgM antibody test typically means that the individual has not been recently infected with the Hepatitis A virus.
atoms.3: IgM antibodies are usually present during an acute or recent Hepatitis A virus infection.
